nodes.label: Allow-Listed Product Adapter
nodes.rationale: A newly constructed allow-listed DTO prevents rejected research fields and arbitrary engine prose from crossing the product boundary.

nodes.label: Deterministic Daily Market Context
nodes.rationale: The panel describes completed daily price and volume context and input trustworthiness without implying a validated buy, sell, or hold recommendation.

nodes.label: Privacy-Preserving Operational Telemetry
nodes.rationale: Closed categorical events and coarse buckets answer reliability questions without recording user, instrument, provider, price, or research data.

nodes.label: Holdout Safeguards
nodes.rationale: Prevent accidental experiment contamination by requiring preregistration, explicit authorization, and one-shot evaluation discipline.

nodes.label: Honest Graph Audit Trail
nodes.rationale: Preserve EXTRACTED, INFERRED, and AMBIGUOUS provenance and surface graph-health defects rather than inventing or hiding edges.

nodes.label: Constrained Query Expansion
nodes.rationale: Expand only with vocabulary actually present in the graph so wording mismatches do not produce empty or fabricated searches.

nodes.label: Replace on Re-Extract
nodes.rationale: Drop prior nodes from a changed source before merging fresh extraction so stale content cannot survive.

nodes.label: Expensive Research Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Avoid costly retrieval, training, full backtests, and sealed evaluation unless explicitly required.

nodes.label: Frozen Artifact Immutability
nodes.rationale: Keep checksum-frozen evidence unchanged and use a new versioned filename instead of replacement.

nodes.label: Deterministic Facts and AI Explanation Boundary
nodes.norm_label: deterministic facts and ai explanation boundary
nodes.rationale: Deterministic code calculates facts while AI may explain uncertainty but cannot invent data, claim certainty, or place orders.

nodes.label: No Validated Trading Signal
nodes.rationale: The research family produced no validated profitable signal, so the product must not present authoritative trade recommendations or automatic orders.

nodes.label: Episode-First One-Shot Validation
nodes.rationale: Episode selection reduces overlapping observations, and a failed preregistered validation gate rejects a candidate without tuning or rerunning the split.

nodes.label: Label-Blind Source Combination and Audit
nodes.rationale: Join frozen sources, preserve provenance, apply fixed splits and purges, and verify integrity without inspecting target values or sealed labels.

nodes.label: Train-Only Episode Materialization
nodes.rationale: Verify the complete checksum but deserialize full features and labels only for train rows, keeping validation and test payloads unopened.

nodes.label: Fixed Splits and Sealed Test Policy
nodes.norm_label: fixed splits and sealed test policy
nodes.rationale: Calendar splits and resolution purges are fixed independently of outcomes; test labels stay sealed until preregistered validation gates pass.

nodes.label: Outcome-Blind Universe and Point-in-Time Liquidity
nodes.rationale: Choose broad candidates without observed returns and determine historical eligibility only from information available at each signal time.

nodes.label: Outcome-Blind Sample Coverage Expansion
nodes.rationale: A 380-episode shortfall justified adding breadth with unchanged targets, features, strategy, validation period, and sealed test.

nodes.label: Clean Non-Overlapping Development Source
nodes.rationale: Fresh instruments and a temporally non-overlapping period avoid tuning the risk-control variant on already consumed momentum outcomes.

nodes.label: Research Restart Sequence
nodes.rationale: A new family must freeze its rationale, source, split boundaries, mechanics, costs, and gates before outcome access, and must stop on source or mandatory-gate failure.

nodes.label: Four-Sleeve 12-Minus-1 Momentum
nodes.rationale: The design tests medium-horizon return persistence through monthly shared-capital portfolio allocation rather than modifying rejected daily setup geometry.

nodes.label: Real-Inbox Rendering Smoke Test
nodes.rationale: Automated HTML assertions cannot reproduce proprietary Gmail, Outlook, and Apple Mail rendering engines, so a real-inbox test remains required.
